primary.title: Micron shares surges after blockbuster earnings: Here's what is driving the rally and how Indians can invest
primary.summary: Micron Technology surpassed Meta Platforms' market valuation and briefly exceeded Tesla's, following a strong forecast that boosted shares by 18.4%. With a market cap of $1.398 trillion, demand for AI-related hardware has led investors to favor Micron among trillion-dollar chipmakers.
